housing: Wychavon is a rural district of market towns and villages around Worcester, mostly owner-occupied with private renting well below the national level. Droitwich Spa, Evesham and Pershore have period centres and large modern estates, while villages have timber-framed and Cotswold stone cottages, many listed. The Vale of Evesham's farms and packhouses mean some homes are let to seasonal and agricultural workers. Riverside towns on the Avon and Severn, such as Evesham, Pershore and Upton, are prone to flooding.
checkinTips: Riverside homes in Evesham, Pershore and Upton-upon-Severn: photograph flood defences, airbricks and watermarks, as these towns flood often.
Timber-framed and black-and-white cottages: photograph beams, infill panels, low doorways and any damp or rot.
Cotswold stone homes in Broadway: check damp at the base of walls, stone slates and timber windows, and record listed features.
Shared homes for farm and packhouse workers in the Vale: record each room's furniture and locks, and check a licence is in place for five or more sharers.
Rural homes off the gas network: note the oil tank level, wood burners and any septic tank.
New-build estates near Worcester and Droitwich: check sealant, flooring and snagging marks, and who maintains shared land.
tenantHelp: Wychavon District Council's Private Sector Housing team investigates disrepair and unsafe conditions in private rented homes and licenses HMOs.
